steps.title: butterspreads.com, page by page
steps.body: butter that loves you back. The store opens on its film, the wordmark in black on the yellow, then The Original Edible Has Evolved: Baking With Butter (turning any recipe into a ritual), Feeling Butter (unwind the day, one spread at a time), Magic Mornings (the original edible, reborn; make bulletproof coffee magic). Cooking Just Got Butter: faster absorption, healthier fat source, versatile use.
steps.source: butterspreads.com, the home page's own words (photographed 2026-10-22)

steps.title: The film, as the store uses it
steps.body: The store's own film plays full-bleed at the top of the home page, under the line butter that loves you back and a Shop now; a second, portrait film plays further down. The same film opens this study and the project's tile on the home page.
steps.alt: The top of butterspreads.com: a woman in yellow holding out a jar of butter, over the film, with butter that loves you back across it.

steps.title: Products
steps.body: Three spreads at $25.00 each: Cookie Butter, Ghee Butter, Hazelnut Butter, each photographed on the yellow, in the jar and in the box.
steps.alt: The Products page of butterspreads.com: three jars in a row with their names and prices.

steps.title: Cookie Butter
steps.body: Live Rosin Infused Cookie Butter. 100MG Delta-9 THC per jar | 3.5oz. Our Live Rosin infused Cookie Butter combines decadent flavor with functional cannabinoids for a balanced experience. Each jar contains 100MG hemp-derived Delta-9 THC, carefully blended with effect-focused cannabinoids tailored for day or night use. Great for desserts, baking, spreading, or spoonful rituals; a reusable and recyclable glass jar. Smooth. Indulgent. Elevated.
steps.alt: The Cookie Butter page: four photographs of the jar and the spread, the description and the Add to cart beside them.

brief: The store at butterspreads.com: a film at the top, the yellow, the wordmark in black on it, the jars and the box with "Let's build a butter world." on it, three spreads at $25 (Cookie Butter, Ghee Butter, Hazelnut Butter), an Education blog and a contact page.
